texts.error.bad_card: Geargrafx cannot use this System Card file: a System Card is 256 KiB, the Games Express card 32 KiB.
texts.error.bad_pac: Geargrafx cannot use this PAC BIOS file: it must be 512 KiB.
texts.error.needs_gexpress: This is a Games Express disc: choose the Games Express card as the System Card.
texts.error.no_card: A CD game needs the System Card in the console's card slot, and none was given.
texts.error.no_file: No game file is in the project.
texts.error.no_pac: A LaserActive disc needs the LD-ROM2 pack's program (the PAC BIOS), and none was given.
texts.error.not_disc: '%1' is not a .cue file. A CD game is given by its .cue file, with the files it names beside it.
texts.firmware.pacbios.about: The program of the LD-ROM2 pack, the PC Engine module of Pioneer's LaserActive. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same file.
texts.firmware.syscard.about: The card in the console's card slot that starts a CD game. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same file.
texts.setting.backupram.about: The 2 KiB of battery-backed memory of a CD console. On, a HuCard also finds it, as on a Duo. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.cdromtype.about: The CD-ROM system: the first CD-ROM2, the Super CD-ROM2 with more memory, or the Arcade CD-ROM2 with the Arcade Card. Auto lets Geargrafx choose from its list of games. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.laseractivebios.about: Which LD-ROM2 pack program the LaserActive runs: a Japanese one or the American one. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.lines.about: How many lines of the picture are shown. It changes the picture only.
texts.setting.machine.about: The console to build: the PC Engine (TurboGrafx-16) for HuCards, the SuperGrafx for its own HuCards, the PC Engine CD for CD games, or the LaserActive for LD-ROM2 discs. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.mb128.about: The MB128, a memory unit some games save to, plugged in before the controller. Auto plugs it in for the games Geargrafx knows use it. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.nospritelimit.about: Draws every sprite on a line, where the console draws 16 at most. Less flicker, but some games draw wrongly. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.overscan.about: Shows the border columns at the left and right of the picture. It changes the picture only.
texts.setting.palette.about: How the console's colours become a screen's. It changes the picture only.
texts.setting.port1.about: What is plugged into the controller port (or the TurboTap's first socket): a two-button pad, an Avenue Pad 3 or 6, or the mouse. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.portn.about: What is plugged into this socket of the TurboTap: a two-button pad, or an Avenue Pad 3 or 6. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.poweron.about: What the registers, colours and memory map hold at power on: random like a real console, made from the seed, or always zero. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.psg.about: The sound chip's revision: the HuC6280 of the first consoles or the later HuC6280A. Auto picks the HuC6280A for the SuperGrafx only. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.randomseed.about: The number the random power-on state is made from. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.region.about: Whether the console reports itself as a Japanese PC Engine or an American TurboGrafx-16; some games check. Auto answers as a TurboGrafx-16, as Geargrafx does. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.systemcard.about: The card in the console's card slot, which starts the disc. Super CD-ROM2 discs need a 3.0 card, Games Express discs the Games Express card. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.turbotap.about: The TurboTap in the controller port, with five sockets for games of up to five players. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.card.help: The game's HuCard file: .pce, or .sgx for a SuperGrafx game.
texts.slot.disc.help: The CD game's .cue file, with the .bin, .img or .iso files it names in the same folder.
texts.slot.laserdisc.help: The LD-ROM2 disc image, an .mmi file.
texts.slot.savedata.help: A saved game to start from: the backup memory (2 KiB) or an MB128 (128 KiB). Without one, both start empty.
